data_quality: vix_52w_range, spx_52w_high and spx_125dma are derived from a 23-week window, not a full 52 weeks: yfinance's ~69-row global budget truncated a 1y weekly pull to 23 of 53 rows for each of 3 symbols. They are ~6-month statistics labelled as such, and they still beat the hardcoded [10,40] VIX default and the neutral-50 placeholders the prior 4 runs used for ma125/rsi14/52w-high. A true 52-week range needs a single-symbol pull.
spx_125dma is the mean of 23 WEEKLY closes (~115 trading days), an approximation of the 125-day MA -- daily bars for 125 sessions do not fit the row budget.
ndx_rsi14 is a real 14-period RSI over 23 daily ^IXIC closes, not a placeholder.
